newsitem.title: USA: Arkansas soybean harvest ahead of yr ago, average.
newsitem.headline: Arkansas soybean harvest ahead of yr ago, average.

text.p: Arkansas's soybean harvest for the week ended Sunday stood at seven percent complete, ahead of the three percent pace of a year ago and average, according to the Arkansas Agricultural Statistics Service.
Fifteen percent of the soybean crop was mature, up from six percent a year ago and ahead of the seven percent average pace.
Corn was 87 percent harvested, down from 89 percent a year ago and ahead of the 85 percent average.
The cotton crop was ahead of average.
The Statistics Service said nine percent of the crop was harvested as of Sunday, up from five percent a year ago and up from the five percent average pace.
Bolls were open on 83 percent of the crop, down from 88 percent a year go but above the 66 percent average.
Wheat was planted on two percent of the acreage, up from zero percent a year ago and the same as the two percent average pace.
